why: Discord keeps its core module in a folder per version, app-1.0.9 and discord_desktop_core-1, both of which change as Discord updates. Greenflagged gives the module path under the user's AppData; the folder names are matched with a wildcard so an update does not hide a patched file.

findings.match: Discord's startup file contains an indicator
